Overview

Mogi das Cruzes is a city in SP with a population of 455,523. A major city in Greater São Paulo, known for its Japanese community, orchid production, and the Serra do Itapety mountain range. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
